The Padi-Thiruninravur highway widening project remains stalled, causing severe traffic congestion, and the district team should push for expedited execution.

MeitY launched the DEPA handbook for secure data sharing in AI training, and the digital services team should review these standards for adoption.
The Greater Chennai Corporation launched a CSR-funded mobile dialysis and kidney screening vehicle, and the office should track healthcare outreach expansion.
The Global Startup Summit 2026 is scheduled for November 14 in Chennai to connect founders and investors, and the office should engage with participants.
